title: Bulk activate shows the count toast and writes Activated with the note
custom_preconds: Admin on sv10647.qa (S2). Two inactive parts A and B.
custom_steps:
1. Inventory → Inactive tab → ⋮ → Activate parts
  2. Tick A and B → Activate
  3. Type note "QA reactivated" → Activate
  4. Open the Active tab
  5. Open Part History for A
custom_expected:
1. Bulk mode opens with a blue, disabled Activate
  2. Confirmation: "Activate parts?", "2 parts selected.", "These parts can be added to new work again.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", Note (Optional), blue Activate
  3. Toast "2 parts updated."; A and B leave Inactive and the mode ends without a page reload
  4. A and B are listed
  5. Entry "Activated | Reason: QA reactivated" with Staff, Date and Time
